meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

howto.what: 装上后，被问及 claude-mem 机制时，Claude会解释：每次读取/编辑/命令会被压缩为观察，会话结束总结，相关记录会在后续会话自动注入；还会说明数据存放在 ~/.claude-mem。
howto.when: 当用户问“claude-mem是怎么工作的”或“这是在做什么”时，这个技能会被用来解释原理。

say.note: Claude会解释捕捉、总结和注入机制。

say.text: 我的记忆数据存在哪里？

say.note: Claude会说明从项目第二次会话起自动注入。

howto.what_en: When asked about claude-mem, Claude explains that each Read/Edit/Bash becomes a compressed observation, summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into later sessions; it also states data lives in ~/.claude-mem.
howto.when_en: When the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?", this skill is used to explain.

say_en.note: Claude explains capture, summarization, and injection.

say_en.text: Where is my memory data stored?
say_en.note: Claude says data stays under ~/.claude-mem on this machine.

say_en.text: When does memory injection kick in?
say_en.note: Claude says it starts from the second session in a project.
